items.title: fix(media): inspect generated images with workspace-only tools (#197812)
items.summary: fix(media): inspect generated images with workspace-only tools (#197812) * fix(media): allow workspaceOnly agents to load their own generated images With tools.fs.workspaceOnly, native image loading restricted localRoots to [workspaceDir], so images written to /media/tool-image-generation/ were rejected. Add getMediaDir() to the host allowlist, consistent with the outbound media rule. Fixes #197767 * fix(media): keep generated images available for inspection Admit the successful producer-owned image outputs through the existing completion-turn attachment path instead of widening workspace-only native image discovery. Preserve host delivery bookkeeping so inspection does not resend generated media. Related: #197767 Co-authored-by: vincentkoc --------- Co-authored-by: vincentkoc
